content:
As the weather turns cooler and peak season for outdoor activities arrives in autumn, I usually adjust my daily carry list to match how I'm spending my time. The Pelican MagSafe wallet and card case is my top pick — it's rugged enough for the outdoors while also being a great everyday wallet.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers covers the latest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of your wireless charging-enabled Apple devices.

The perfect companion for outdoor activities

The Pelican wallet carries an IPX4 water-resistance rating, meaning if you get caught in a drizzle on a hike or by the lake, your credit cards and cash will stay dry. The wallet snaps shut and locks firmly once closed. In my case, autumn often means heading to Falcons games, and even at a football match I like knowing everything is tucked away and locked inside. That alone makes it a solid pick for fall outings — the weather can be unpredictable this time of year. Rather than feeling like a wallet that sticks to the back of your phone, it feels more like a small hard-shell protective case.

Most MagSafe wallets on the market are designed to hold just a few cards with little room for anything else. Pelican's design offers a little more flexibility. It can easily accommodate an ID and credit cards, with space for a small amount of folded cash and a slim key. If you're looking to keep things light on a hike, this wallet covers the essentials without needing to bring along an extra bag.

While the Pelican wallet is geared toward outdoor use, it works just as well as an everyday carry. The strong magnet holds it firmly to the back of an iPhone, and the snap closure keeps everything from falling out. Compared with flimsier MagSafe wallets, this one trades a bit of slimness for greater peace of mind. When I want a minimal setup in summer, it isn't my first choice — but for hiking, football games, or any outdoor activity where the weather could turn at any moment, it's the right call. It's also a great MagSafe wallet for a kid's first iPhone. My oldest has been using one for a couple of years now.

Pelican MagSafe wallet — the bottom line

The Pelican MagSafe wallet is built for anyone who values durability. It protects your essentials from weather and rain, holds enough for a hike or day trip, and stays securely attached to the back of your phone. If you want a MagSafe wallet that can take a beating and still work for daily use, this is it.

You can pick up the Pelican MagSafe wallet through Amazon or directly from Pelican's website.
